name: Yamaha XJ550 Maxim / Seca
engine: 528 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four Mikuni carbs, YICS
intro: A light, quick Yamaha four. Carb setup is fussy, and the YICS passage plugs matter.

add.title: Check the YICS passage plugs
add.instructions: Look at both ends of the YICS passage in the cylinder head. The plugs must be there and sealed.
add.reason: A missing YICS plug causes starting and idle problems.

G: The XJ550 carb rack is fussy. Set the float heights, then check the fuel level with the bike running.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: YICS plugs
known.what: Missing plugs at the ends of the YICS passage upset idle and starting.
